this does not cause any bugs, but triggers a not needed dom OP.

```
            if (movedNode) {

                // todo: check if there is a real index change

                deltas.push({
                    action: 'moveNode',
                    id      : oldVnode.id,
                    index   : movedNode.index,
                    parentId: movedNode.parentNode.id
                });
```
